input.quote: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the "Effective Date") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice, the Termination Date and the Termination Payment owed by the Company; it says nothing about exit. HDI hosts the Site on its own server (1.3), holds our Content (2.1), export/order files (1.5) and user information (8.1), yet no provision anywhere requires HDI to provide migration or transition assistance, to return or export that data, or to delete it on a defined timetable. Section 10.7 survival covers only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10, and the confidentiality provisions impose use/disclosure restrictions but no return obligation. This falls short of even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days) and leaves us exposed to loss of our own customer and order data at termination. Proposed insertion of a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Content and data in a machine-readable format within 30 days (including Site access credentials), and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide transition assistance, return Company data/Content, and certify deletion after termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition and data-return provision, as the Agreement is silent on what happens to our Content, customer and order data when hosting ends. Our position is up to six months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if that is easier operationally.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including migration of the Site and cooperation in the transfer of hosting to the Company or its designee, for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, deliver to the Company all Content, customer and user information, order data and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, together with any access credentials relating to the Site and the URL; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
